jobs_results.title: Lead Frontend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
At Mangopay, our mission is to power the payment infrastructure and payment operations of the world's biggest and most exciting marketplaces & platforms.

We provide marketplaces and platforms with powerful modular payment and regulatory solutions. Since 2013, we have enabled the success of some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and cutting-edge platforms such as Vinted, Rakuten, Chrono24, La Redoute, Wallapop and over 2,500+ more.

Our team of 400+ is spread across Europe, with offices in Berlin, Dublin, Luxembourg, London, Madrid, Paris, and Warsaw. In an environment where marketplaces and fintech ventures are thriving, we're actively seeking exceptional individuals to tackle the challenges in our field and contribute to our growth. Our commitment to diversity is unwavering, and we are dedicated to promoting employee well-being, inclusivity, and equal opportunities. Joining Mangopay means you’ll be part of a dynamic, flexible, and rapidly growing team.

Job Description

We... are looking for an experienced Frontend Software Engineer to contribute to the development and maintenance of our cutting-edge payment platform. The ideal candidate will be proficient in front-end technologies, possess a strong understanding of UI/UX principles, and have a passion for creating seamless user experiences. As a key member of our engineering team, you will collaborate closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers to deliver high-quality solutions that meet the needs of our clients and customers.

You can work remotely in one of these locations: France/Poland/UK/Germany/Spain/Ireland/Luxembourg.

What you'll be doing:
• Architect the front-end strategy by designing scalable and maintainable solutions using modern front-end frameworks such as Vue.js or React.js
• Be the owner of FE strategy across the company
• Utilize TypeScript for robust and type-safe development
• Collaborate with design teams to translate UI/UX designs into functional web applications
• Optimize application performance for maximum speed and scalability
• Obsessive attention to detail and a commitment to delivering pixel-perfect applications
• Conduct code reviews, identify areas for improvement, and implement best practices
• Stay updated on emerging front-end technologies and industry trends
• Knowledge of micro front-end and distributed applications is highly desirable

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
• Proven experience as a Frontend Software Engineer or similar role
• Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, and front-end frameworks/libraries (Vue.js, React.js, etc.)
• Experience with RESTful APIs and asynchronous programming
• Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, agile environment
• Strong capability in both written and verbal English

We care about equal employment opportunities, so all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration regardless of their race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status

jobs_results.title: Senior Front End Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are a high-growth Series-B InsurTech start-up using data and machine learning to revolutionize the insurance industry. You will be joining a strong and mission driven team, working to build a customer facing product that fundamentally changes the way insurers evaluate risk, enabling them to move from highly manual workflows to digital risk flows.

Cytora’s Risk Stream is a serverless and cloud native SaaS platform that automates the digitisation, evaluation and decisioning of risks for commercial insurers. Our product drastically improves the working lives of our users, enables our customers to cover more risks, more competitively.

Who are we looking for?

As a Senior Front End Engineer at Cytora, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our product. Working closely with UX designers, engineers, and product managers, you will contribute to building powerful solutions that empower our clients to harness the potential of our diverse product APIs.

Your responsibilities... will extend to providing valuable feedback to product managers, influencing product roadmaps, and collaborating with our product designer function to establish best practices.

What You Will Be Doing
• Collaborate within an Agile team to develop and maintain full-stack JavaScript production-grade web applications.
• Utilize your expertise in JavaScript frameworks and libraries, particularly React, Typescript, and Redux, to create seamless user experiences.
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of agile fundamentals, contributing to an efficient and collaborative development process.
• Work with APIs and services to integrate and optimize functionality.

Skills Required To Be Successful
• Significant experience building and maintaining full-stack JavaScript production-grade web applications.
• Commercial experience with JavaScript frameworks and libraries.
• Strong working knowledge of agile fundamentals and frameworks.
• A team player who can work with various people across the business as well as being comfortable with autonomy
• Experience working with APIs and services.
• Ability to contribute autonomously to the product with several years of hands-on experience building software products.

Nice to Have:
• Experience in UX/UI design to enhance user interactions and experiences.
• Start-up experience: Proven ability to rapidly build and deliver working products.

Benefits
• Stock options
• Enhanced parental leave
• Private health insurance - UK + US only*
• Choice of laptop
• Flexi-working
• £2000 travel budget
• Company trips
• We employ people across the UK and Spain (using a 3rd party Employer of Record model), and inevitably the benefits that we can offer vary slightly in different territories, due to local employment law and feasibility. Our salary range does not vary depending on territory.

At Cytora, we understand that diverse backgrounds bring unique perspectives. We welcome applications from individuals with varying levels of experience, acknowledging that years of experience do not necessarily equate to skill level. If you're passionate about pushing the boundaries of technology, thrive in a collaborative environment, and are excited about the prospect of contributing to a cutting-edge product, we want to hear from you!

Join us on our exciting journey - apply now and be a key player in shaping the future of Cytora's Frontend function

jobs_results.title: Senior Front End Developer
jobs_results.description:
I am currently supporting a Global Consultancy on the lookout for Senior Front-end Engineers.

our client's dynamic JavaScript team is immersed in the development of an in-house system tailored for the management of over 15+ different clients. Leveraging experience putting them at the forefront on innovation.

This is a hybrid position in Marbella, applicants must be able to commit to 2-3 days onsite per week!

I am looking for Senior Engineers with 5+ years experience focussed on the front-end.
• Strong proficiency in Javascript and Typescript
• Extensive use of React.js and its core principles
• Experience Cloudflare, Node.js, Graphql

If you are interested please apply or reach out directly - lauren@velocity-tech.co 😊
